project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA with Vite bundler
build_system: Vite + tsc for type checking, no brazil/make
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, setup in src/test-setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' (tsc -b && vite build) to verify types and bundle. 2. Run 'npx vitest run' to run all tests.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - npm install works. No Docker daemon needed. Supabase client configured but queries will fail without env vars - tests mock Supabase calls.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, all exports from stores barrel (stores/index.ts), use @/ path alias, test files in __tests__ directories adjacent to source
key_patterns: Zustand stores with create(), fromTable() helper for Supabase queries, optimistic updates with rollback, data-testid attributes on interactive elements, Vitest describe/it/expect with beforeEach resets, use useCanvasStore.setState() for test setup
directory_structure: frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores (authStore, canvasStore, projectStore, index barrel), frontend/src/components/ - UI panels (Toolbar, ZonePropertiesPanel, MeasurementPanel), frontend/src/canvas/ - Konva canvas container and layers, frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces (database.ts, canvas.ts), frontend/src/lib/ - supabase client, frontend/src/hooks/ - empty
